name: zythologue
description: Monorepo pnpm du brief Zythologue : apps/api (Express) + apps/client (à venir).

scripts.db:schema: docker compose exec -T postgres sh -c "psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U \$POSTGRES_USER -d \$POSTGRES_DB -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01_create_schema.sql"
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres sh -c "psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U \$POSTGRES_USER -d \$POSTGRES_DB -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02_seed.sql"
